title: Turtles in Space
description: A surreal painting shows three elderly men wearing hats and coats riding a large green sea turtle floating through a purple cosmic sky. Below them is a starry black landscape with smaller sketched turtles, a glowing crystal ball containing sea creatures, and a red ringed planet with a face in the upper right.
